name: i.safe MOBILE IS940.1
summary: The i.safe MOBILE IS940.1 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ib) 10.1-inch Android tablet from i.safe MOBILE, certified for Zone 1/21 under ATEX and IECEx. It runs Android 14.

otherSchemes: IA South Africa (MTEx-S/24.0456 X), PCEC China (CE24.5940X), INMETRO (BRA 24.GE0015X), Japan-Ex, PESO, KCs

atex.marking: II 2G Ex ib IIC T4 Gb / II 2D Ex ib IIIC T135°C Db
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 1 (2025-02-06), checked 2026-10-25. ATEX per DoC 1065CC05REV02; ATEX PDF is a scan and was not read.

iecex.marking: Ex ib IIC T4 Gb / Ex ib IIIC T135°C Db

certification.northAmerica: NEC 500 (QPS LR3081-7, 2025-08-13): Class I Div 1 Groups A, B, C, D T4; Class II Div 1 Groups E, F, G 155 °C; Class III; IP64; −20 °C to +55 °C

safety.conditions: Battery may be replaced outside explosion hazardous areas only; protect against excessive UV light and high electrostatic charge; USB-C interface under IP cover may only be opened outside hazardous areas; 16-pin ISM interface must be closed with its cover when not in use in hazardous areas; ambient −20 °C to +55 °C; charging temperature limited to 0 °C to +45 °C (IECEx EPS 24.0001X issue 1). Safety instructions: protect from high-energy impacts; zones 1, 2, 21, 22 only.
safety.peripherals: USB-C and 16-pin ISM covers closed in Ex areas. In Ex areas only these may be connected to the 16-pin ISM: headset IS-HS2A.1, remote speaker microphone IS-RSM3A.1, PTT button IS-PTTB1A.1 (with or without headset IS-HDHS1x.1). The 12-pin dock interface may stay open. Nano-SIM and microSD (IS-SD164.1 / IS-SD1128.1 or cards meeting the entity parameters) allowed in their slots in the Ex area.
safety.certifiedAccessories: Ex-rated for use in Ex area: IS-HS2A.1 headset, IS-RSM3A.1 speaker microphone, IS-PTTB1A.1 PTT button, IS-HDHS1A/B/C.1 headsets (headband, neckband, helmet), IS-DS940.1 docking station, microSD IS-SD164.1/IS-SD1128.1. Charging via IS-DS940.1 or MC930.1 multi charger; PROTECTOR 2.0 USB-C cable only outside Ex areas. Leather cases, vehicle mount, carry straps also listed.

specs.display: 10.1-inch Corning Gorilla Glass V3 (3rd generation), usable with gloves
specs.ports: USB-C; 12-pin docking interface; 16-pin ISM interface (audio/PTT accessories; the page text also calls it '13-pin'); nano-SIM + eSIM; microSD
specs.docking: IS-DS940.1 docking station (VESA 100; charging in Ex area); IS-MC930.1 six-bay multi charger; vehicle mount
specs.gnss: GPS, A-GPS, Glonass, A-Glonass, Beidou, Galileo
specs.keys: Freely programmable red key (e.g. lone worker / SOS); additional programmable side buttons
specs.touch: Usable with gloves (maker); wet-touch not stated
specs.pen: Passive stylus available as accessory (IS-Stylus Set, 'stylus for operating touch screens'); not in the box
specs.partNumbers: Model M940A01; battery BPIS940A.1A (MBP940AA01) per DoC; R. STAHL Art. No. 329056 (Tablet Set), 329467 (Tablet Set no Camera)

capabilities.label: Push-to-talk
capabilities.value: Via accessory (IS-PTTB1A.1 PTT button on the 16-pin ISM interface; Ex-rated? yes) and PTT app

capabilities.label: Emergency / SOS
capabilities.value: Built in (freely programmable red key, e.g. SOS / lone worker)

capabilities.label: Lone worker
capabilities.value: Via app (red key assigned to a lone-worker application; third-party app)

capabilities.label: Barcode scanning
capabilities.value: Via app (50 MP camera-based; no dedicated scan engine listed)

capabilities.label: Remote expert / video calls
capabilities.value: Via app (front and rear cameras, Wi-Fi 6 / 5G; third-party app)

variants.name: IS-MOP1A.1 Mobile Operator Panel
variants.description: The IS940.1 combined with the IS-CS1A.1 connectivity system as a docked operator panel. The connectivity module needs a separate Ex enclosure.
variants.certificates: EPS 24 ATEX 1 010 X; IECEx EPS 24.0001X issue 1

variants.name: IS940.M1
variants.description: Mining version, also certified for Group I (underground mining).
